question: The average bankruptcy rate and M&A deals by year
query: SELECT      EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) AS Year,      AVG(bankruptcy_rate) AS Average_Bankruptcy_Rate,     COUNT(mergers_acquisitions_deals) / NULLIF(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date), 0) AS Avg_Mergers_Acquisitions_Deals FROM finance_economics_dataset GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) ORDER BY Year DESC LIMIT 50;
